paras: Application: Nissan/Infiniti VQ35HR and VQ37VHR engines with Radium 20-0458 fuel rails Part Type: Fuel rail plumbing kit Part Number: 20-0469

Used with the Radium 20-0458 Nissan VQ fuel rails, this plumbing kit makes the rail upgrade a bolt-on installation on VQ35HR and VQ37VHR engines, routing fuel to the front rail ports. Two 20-0459 adapters are included so both OEM fuel pulse dampers can be reused.
hl: Bolt-On: Plumbing for Radium 20-0458 rails on the VQ35HR/VQ37VHR
Front Port Feed: Routes fuel to the front rail ports
Reuse OEM Dampers: Two 20-0459 8AN ORB to Nissan FPD adapters included
OEM Connection: 5/16" SAE to 6AN male adapter
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Rail Plumbing Kit for Nissan 350Z 07-09/370Z/Skyline V36/Infiniti G35/G36 V36 VQ35HR/VQ37VHR
